reference_products: Directus Data Studio — the two-tier navigation (narrow dark icon rail for modules + light nav panel for the items inside a module), the eyebrow-over-title page header with a circular back button, the persistent right-hand info/options drawer, round icon buttons for destructive/confirm actions, and the habit of writing state as small coloured text ('Saves Automatically' in amber) rather than as a banner

Strapi Content Manager — the grey canvas / white card split, grouped left nav with count badges and a tinted active row with a left accent bar, the table itself (uppercase 11px column headers, checkbox column, sortable caret, hairline row rules, no zebra, no vertical grid), 'N entries found' under the title, the right meta rail of small cards (ENTRY / RELEASES) holding publish + save actions, and outlined status pills

Payload admin panel — the extreme restraint: a sidebar that is just a flat list of link text with no icons, a monochrome grid of grey-filled cards on white, hairline dividers, and essentially zero colour outside links and one primary button. This is the ceiling on how much chrome the built UI should have

Buildkite pipeline build card — the run-identity vocabulary: build number and branch on one small monospace line under a commit-subject title, per-step chips each prefixed by a status glyph, elapsed time as plain right-aligned text ('Running for 4s'), and a split 'Rebuild' button as the primary row action

design_tokens.palette: Three planes, in this order of area: a 44px near-black nav rail (#161B22, icons at 60% white, active icon full white on a #21262D block); a light nav panel (#F2F4F7) and a near-white app canvas (#F7F8FA); white (#FFFFFF) cards and tables sitting on that canvas. Text is near-black (#111827) for primary, #5B6472 for secondary/labels, #8A94A3 for placeholders and disabled. Borders are one hairline value, #E3E7EC, used everywhere — card edge, table row rule, input outline — with a slightly darker #D3D9E0 only on hover/focus outlines. Exactly one accent, an indigo-blue #3B5BDB: links, the active nav item's tint (#EDF1FD fill + 2px #3B5BDB left bar), the focus ring (2px at 30% alpha), and the single filled primary button per screen. Status colour appears ONLY inside chips, log gutters and the 3px left edge of a build-report row, never as a filled row background: pass #1F7A45 on #E8F5EC / border #C3E4CE, fail #B3261E on #FDECEA / border #F5C9C4, running #8A5A00 on #FDF3E0 / border #F0DBB0, queued/skipped #5B6472 on #F0F2F5 / border #DDE1E7. Log output is a #FBFBFC pane with a #EDEFF2 line-number gutter, timestamps in #8A94A3, stderr lines in #B3261E, no dark terminal theme. No gradients, no coloured headers, no brand block of colour anywhere above the fold.
design_tokens.typography: UI: system stack (-apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Inter, sans-serif). Page title 22px/600, section heading 15px/600, body and form labels 13px/500, table cells 13px/400, secondary metadata 12px/400, column headers 11px/600 uppercase with 0.06em tracking in #5B6472, helper text 11px/400. Mono: ui-monospace/'JetBrains Mono'/Menlo at 12px, and it carries real semantic weight — build IDs (#3421), commit SHAs (a4f9c21), branch names, durations (2m 14s), taxonomy slugs, content-type keys, API paths and every log line are monospace; prose titles and human names are not. Numbers in table columns are tabular-figures and right-aligned. No italics except a single muted 'no items' empty state.
design_tokens.density: Compact but not cramped — an engineer's table, 40 rows visible without scrolling on a 900px viewport. Table row 34px with 12px horizontal cell padding, header row 32px, nav item 30px, button 28px, input 32px. Card padding 16px; page gutter 24px; 20px between a page header and the first card. Line-height 1.45 for prose, 1.3 inside tables. Log lines 18px tall, no padding between them.
design_tokens.components: Table: white, hairline bottom rule per row, NO vertical rules and NO zebra striping; leading 32px checkbox column; sortable headers show a 8px caret only on the active sort; hover tints the row #F7F8FA; the row's status lives in a 3px coloured left edge plus a chip in the first data column. Chips: 20px tall, 3px radius, 11px/600, tinted fill + 1px tinted border + a 6px glyph (✓ ✕ ● ◔) — pills only, never filled blocks. Buttons: 4px radius, 28px, primary = solid #3B5BDB white text (one per screen), secondary = white with #D3D9E0 border, tertiary = borderless #3B5BDB text; destructive is a text button in #B3261E, never a red filled button. Split button (action + ▾) for re-run style actions. Forms: label above control, 32px inputs with a 1px #E3E7EC border and 4px radius, focus swaps border to #3B5BDB with a 2px 30%-alpha ring; two-column field grid at ≥1100px; helper text under the field, error text in #B3261E under that; no floating labels, no inline label columns. Right meta rail: 260px stack of white cards, each with an 11px uppercase title rule at top and full-width stacked buttons. Drawer: 320px, slides from the right, hairline left border, collapsible sections with chevrons — used for filters, layout options and activity/audit trails. Popovers and dropdowns are the only elements with a shadow (0 4px 12px rgba(16,24,40,.10)); cards and the rail have none. Icons: 16px stroke line icons, present in the rail, in chips, and on icon-only buttons; absent from table cells and form labels.
design_tokens.spacing: 4px base unit, 8px rhythm. Rail 44px, nav panel 232px, right rail 260px, drawer 320px, content max-width 1240px then centred. 24px page gutter, 16px card padding, 12px between stacked form fields, 8px between a label and its control, 6px gap inside a chip, 8px between inline actions, 32px above a new section heading. Zero radius on the rail and nav panel; 6px on cards; 4px on controls; 3px on chips.

structural_notes: The chrome is three vertical zones plus a header, and it never changes: a fixed 44px near-black icon rail on the far left switching between the top-level apps (authoring, taxonomy, delivery, settings) with the user avatar pinned to its bottom; a 232px light nav panel listing what lives inside the selected app as grouped lists with small uppercase group headers and right-aligned count badges (the active row tinted with a 2px left accent bar); then the canvas. There is no global top bar spanning the window — the page header sits inside the canvas: a small grey eyebrow line ('Content / Build Reports') above a 22px title, an item count or run-identity line under it ('148 entries' or '#3421 · main · a4f9c21' in mono), and right-aligned actions where only the rightmost is filled. Lists are a single white card on the canvas holding a dense table; filtering is a toolbar row above the card (search box, Filters button, saved-view selector) and never a left-hand facet column. Selecting a row navigates rather than expanding; the detail surface reuses the same header and replaces the table with a two-column body — the record's own fields in white cards on the left, and a 260px right rail of small meta cards (status/publish actions, taxonomy assignments, timing, related run) — so list and detail read as the same screen with the middle swapped. Secondary information (filters, layout options, activity log, raw payload) opens in a right slide-over drawer over the canvas, not a modal; modals are reserved for destructive confirmations. A build report's log is a full-width monospace pane at the bottom of the detail view with a line-number gutter, collapsible step groups whose headers carry the step's status chip and duration, and a copy-link affordance on line selection. Publishing state is shown twice and only twice: as a chip in the list row and as a chip beside the detail title — never as a coloured page banner. Empty states are one line of muted 13px text inside the card, no illustration.
_look: a utilitarian internal tool that looks built by engineers, not designers
